key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1472
name: clear_output_entry_flags
description: Walks an array of eight-byte entries starting from a pointer held in the device state, clearing the flag byte of each entry until a minus-one terminator. It then sets the flag byte of the final entry to a fixed high-bit value.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:148A
name: clear_entries_until_match
description: Steps through eight-byte entries from a pointer register, clearing each entry's flag byte until the entry's first byte equals a value passed in a data register. It then sets the final entry's flag byte to a fixed high-bit value.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1492
name: expand_speech_parameter_stream
description: Reads a code stream ending in a minus-one byte. Code 23 smooths two neighbouring parameter bytes, while other codes look up table values and flag bits and write them into the output parameter arrays.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:14B2
name: expand_speech_codes_register_entry
description: Second entry point of the same code-stream expander, taking its table and output pointers from address registers. It applies the same neighbour smoothing for code 23 and the same table and flag writes for other codes.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:14E6
name: emit_speech_code_values
description: Variant of the code-stream expander that starts at the table lookup for the current code. It writes table values and flag nibbles into the output arrays and continues until the minus-one terminator.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1510
name: emit_table_value_stream
description: Writes the table value selected by the current code into the output array and sets flag bits from the following code. It continues through the stream, smoothing neighbours for code 23, until the terminator.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1558
name: apply_nibble_flags_stream
description: Sets the low flag nibble of each output entry from bits of the current code, choosing among a few fixed values. It copies table values alongside and loops over the stream until the terminator.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1564
name: apply_flag_bit_stream
description: Sets the low flag nibble of each output entry from the code's flag bits and copies smoothed table values across the stream. It stops at the minus-one terminator.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1572
name: apply_lower_flag_nibble
description: Sets the low flag nibble of the current output entry to one of four small values depending on bits of the next code. It advances through the stream copying smoothed values.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:157C
name: copy_smoothed_speech_values
description: Copies table values into the output parameter arrays for each code in the stream, averaging neighbouring bytes for code 23 and writing flag nibbles. It ends at the minus-one terminator.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1586
name: allocate_speech_output_buffers
description: Sums the duration entries of a table up to its terminator, storing the total and a size of eight bytes per unit plus eight. It then requests memory from the system for the output buffer and, when a secondary flag is set, a second block.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:15A0
name: allocate_sized_output_buffer
description: Stores the frame count, computes a buffer size of eight bytes per frame plus eight, and requests that memory from the system. It keeps the returned pointer and, when the secondary flag is set, makes a second allocation.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:15C2
name: store_buffer_then_allocate_extra
description: Stores the passed pointer as the primary buffer. When the secondary-buffer flag is set, it requests a second block from the system library and stores its pointer.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:15E0
name: render_speech_token_frames
description: Iterates over the token list until its terminator, looking up per-token values in several tables and adjusting them when a flag bit is set. It writes each token's values into the output buffers for as many frames as its duration field gives.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:160A
name: write_token_frames_buffer
description: For each token, writes eight-byte frame records into the output buffer, filling the fields from lookup tables and flag bits. Each token is repeated for its duration, until the terminator is reached.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:16B8
name: write_frame_records_terminated
description: Expands each token into eight-byte frame records using its duration, copying three lookup values, three computed bytes and a flag byte per frame. It then writes eight terminator bytes at the end of the buffer.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:172A
name: interpolate_between_frames
description: Walks the frame records and, for tokens carrying the blend flags, moves the stored parameter bytes toward the next token's values in six steps using a weighted average.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1762
name: blend_adjacent_frame_values
description: Register-based variant of the frame blending pass. It computes a weighted average between adjacent parameter bytes over six steps and writes the results back, advancing by each token's duration.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:177A
name: blend_frame_record_transitions
description: Blends parameter bytes across token boundaries in the frame records, weighting them with a lookup table. It steps forward by each token's duration until the terminator.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:17A8
name: blend_frame_transition_steps
description: Performs six-step weighted blending between each pair of adjacent frame parameter values, advancing through the records until the terminator.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:17D2
name: blend_frame_values_next_token
description: Continues the frame blending pass, moving to the next token whenever the current duration runs out. It blends the stored parameter bytes with a weighted average until the terminator.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:17D6
name: build_token_ramp_records
description: For each token, computes a per-frame ramp of values between neighbouring table entries over the token's duration. It writes the results as four-byte records into the output buffer, stopping at the terminator.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:181E
name: write_ramp_records_alt
description: Register-based variant of the ramp builder. It computes values across each token's frames from neighbouring table entries, writes four-byte records and fills the pad bytes with a fixed constant.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1844
name: emit_ramp_records_until_end
description: Continues writing ramp records for each token, reading the next code and its duration, until the terminator. Each record takes its values from table lookups for the current and neighbouring codes.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:186E
name: emit_ramp_records_stepping
description: Steps through the token list writing four-byte ramp records and updating the running count for each frame. It returns when the terminator is reached.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1880
name: emit_ramp_records_padded
description: Writes ramp records for the current token and then pads the remaining slots of the frame with a fixed constant when the segment flag is clear.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:18B8
name: emit_ramp_records_branching
description: Writes ramp records for each token, choosing between two flag-derived values depending on bits of the current code's table entry before continuing to the next token.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:190E
name: fill_ramp_record_segment
description: Fills a run of four-byte ramp records with the computed values for the current token segment, using the segment length counter to end each run.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:191A
name: fill_zero_ramp_records
description: Writes zeroed four-byte records followed by a fixed pad value for the remaining frames of the current token segment, then continues with the next token.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:193A
name: fill_ramp_records_counted
description: Writes counted runs of four-byte ramp records for each token segment, computing the step values from neighbouring table entries until the terminator is reached.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1946
name: emit_ramp_records_tail
description: Finishes writing ramp records for the last token segment, computing the step values from neighbouring table entries and advancing the output pointer until the terminator.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1966
name: fill_ramp_records_with_flags
description: Writes runs of four-byte records whose length comes from a count in a data register, filling each record from table values and flag bits before moving to the next segment.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1970
name: filter_token_list_entries
description: Copies the token list and its two parallel arrays into compacted positions, dropping tokens whose table entry has a particular flag bit set. It then writes a terminator at the end of each array.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:19B0
name: write_byte_to_three_pointers
description: Stores one byte from a data register into the three memory locations pointed to by three address registers.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:19BC
name: call_two_routines_in_sequence
description: Calls two other routines one after the other and returns. It has no logic of its own.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:19C4
name: set_token_flag_bits
description: Clears the low nibble of each flag entry, then walks the token list setting bit flags on the flag entries for each token and its group boundaries.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:19D8
name: mark_token_boundary_flags
description: Walks the token list and sets marker bits on the flag entries that bracket each token's duration. The marks depend on the token's table flags and the following code, and the walk stops at the terminator.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:19F2
name: set_token_boundary_markers
description: Register-based variant of the boundary marker pass. It sets marker bits on the flag entries around each token and advances through the token list until the terminator.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1A24
name: set_boundary_markers_midloop
description: Continues the boundary marker pass from the middle of the loop. It sets the same marker bits on the flag entries and returns at the terminator.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1A48
name: set_boundary_markers_alt
description: Alternate form of the boundary marker pass that sets the marker bits one entry after each token boundary and returns at the terminator.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1A72
name: set_boundary_markers_entry
description: Enters the boundary marker pass by setting a marker bit on the current flag entry, then walks the token list setting bits on the flag entries that bracket each token until the terminator.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1A78
name: set_boundary_markers_restart
description: Restarts the boundary marker pass at its second marker position, setting the same marker bits on the flag entries around each token until the terminator.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1A8E
name: compute_period_frame_records
description: Computes a period by dividing a fixed constant by a stored rate, then walks the token tables. For each token it writes period-divided values into the frame records, interpolating between neighbouring pitch entries when a flag is set.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1AF0
name: write_interpolated_period_records
description: Register-based variant of the period record writer. It divides the stored period by neighbouring pitch values, writes the results into the frame records and interpolates between the two ends of each token segment.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1B00
name: write_period_records_loop
description: Loops over tokens writing period-divided bytes into the frame records, weighting each step between neighbouring pitch values by the token's flag bits until the terminator.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1B34
name: finish_period_records_tail
description: Writes the final period-divided byte of the frame records and returns once the terminator is reached, using the last table entry as the divisor.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1B48
name: write_period_records_branch
description: Writes period-divided bytes for each token segment, choosing between two interpolation paths depending on a flag bit in the current code's table entry.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1BB4
name: write_period_records_segment
description: Writes period-divided bytes for the current token segment and advances to the next token, interpolating neighbouring pitch values until the segment flag clears.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1BCA
name: write_scaled_period_bytes
description: Divides a stored rate by a fixed divisor and writes the result into the seventh byte of each eight-byte record until the terminator.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1BE4
name: stub_empty_return
description: Empty routine whose body only returns to its caller.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1BE8
name: dispatch_token_rule_handlers
description: Walks the token list until its terminator, testing flag bits of each token and its neighbours, and calls the matching handler routines to adjust the current segment.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1C22
name: run_token_rule_checks
description: Register-based form of the token rule pass. It tests the same table flag bits for each token and calls the matching handler routines until the terminator.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1C3A
name: step_token_rule_checks
description: Advances through the token list one token at a time, testing the same flag bits and calling handler routines for each matching token until the terminator.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1C42
name: apply_token_rule_steps
description: Applies the token rule handlers in sequence for the current token, testing flag bits of the token and its neighbours before advancing the output and input pointers.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1CBA
name: check_neighbour_token_flags
description: Compares the flags of the tokens before and after the current one and calls handler routines depending on which carry the relevant bits. It loops while the stream continues.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1CD2
name: check_neighbour_token_flags_alt
description: Second entry into the neighbour flag check. It tests the flags of the surrounding tokens and calls the matching handler routines before continuing through the stream.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1CE2
name: check_neighbour_token_pair
description: Checks the flag pair formed by the current token and its successor, calling handler routines for each combination of bits that is set.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1CFC
name: scale_neighbour_parameter_value
description: Looks up a parameter for the current token, halving it when the relevant flag bits are clear, and passes control to the neighbour handler routines.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1D0C
name: apply_neighbour_rule_checks
description: Runs the neighbour rule checks for the current token, calling handler routines when the preceding token carries the relevant bits. It walks the flag tables until the next token is reached.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1D8A
name: blend_token_parameter_values
description: Computes a weighted blend between a stored parameter and the table value for the current token. It adds a small offset when a flag pair is set, clamps the result to 63, and writes it into the output record.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1DA4
name: blend_parameter_stream_loop
description: Loops over a stream of codes, computing blended parameter bytes from the table value and the previous byte. Each result is clamped to 63 and merged into the low bits of the output record until the terminator.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1DAC
name: blend_parameter_stream_alt
description: Alternate entry into the parameter blend loop, with the same table lookups, clamping to 63 and merging into the output records until the terminator.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1E12
name: compute_scaled_shifted_product
description: Multiplies the low word of one register by a word input and returns a pair of values: the high half of the product and the low half after adding sixteen and shifting right five bits.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1E1C
name: initialize_and_clear_buffers
description: Stores the offsets of the speech tables and buffers into the device state structure, advances several of those pointers and clears a set of word fields. It then zeroes the buffers over a fixed number of iterations.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1EE0
name: advance_counter_dispatch_calls
description: Increments a 16-bit counter in the device state and calls one unnamed routine. When the counter did not wrap to zero or overflow, it also calls four more unnamed routines in sequence.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1F02
name: encode_frame_level_nibbles
description: Walks the code and parameter streams, scaling each parameter by a fixed fraction and writing it as a low nibble into the frame buffer. It marks frames whose scaled value passes a threshold and stops after 128 entries.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1F58
name: write_frame_level_nibbles_loop
description: Register-based loop of the frame nibble writer. It writes scaled parameter nibbles into the frame buffer, sets the threshold marks and stops after 128 entries.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1F76
name: write_frame_nibbles_tail
description: Writes the last scaled nibble of the current frame run into the frame buffer and updates the frame counters, returning once 128 entries have been written.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1FC0
name: set_flag_and_store_indices
description: Sets a flag bit in the frame byte before the current index, then stores the current index and, when no marker was recorded, a fallback index into two fields of the device state.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1FD8
name: mark_frame_flags_by_code
description: Walks the code and table streams, setting flag bits in the frame buffer according to each code's table entry and whether a break code occurs. It stops at the terminator or at a stop-bit code.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2010
name: mark_stream_flags_loop
description: Walks the code and parameter streams, adding to a counter on negative parameter bytes and setting marker bits in the flag buffer for code 4 and for flagged positions. It stops at the terminator.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2032
name: mark_stream_flags_alt
description: Alternate entry into the stream flag marking loop, with the same counter updates and marker bits for code 4 until the terminator.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2054
name: propagate_marker_flags_backward
description: Walks the flag buffer backwards from the current index, OR-ing marker bits. For entries of certain codes it moves or clears values along neighbouring entries in one direction.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:206C
name: scan_marker_flags_downward
description: Scans the flag buffer downward from the current index, OR-ing a stored bit into each entry. For codes 2 and 14 it copies values across marked neighbours, then clears the source entry.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:208E
name: step_marker_flags_neighbours
description: Steps through the flag buffer one neighbour at a time, applying the marker bit and value copies for codes 2 and 14 until the index passes the end of the buffer.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:20A8
name: swap_and_clear_byte_flags
description: Copies a value between two positions in the table, clearing the source when the positions differ. It then ORs a flag byte into the next entry and propagates the operation forward or backward depending on the code stored there.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:20BC
name: set_low_bit_flags_backward
description: Sets the lowest bit of each byte in a flag buffer, counting down from the current count to zero.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:20C4
name: set_low_bit_flags_countdown
description: Sets bit one in each byte of a buffer, counting down from the given index to zero.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:20D0
name: or_mask_buffer_early_exit
description: Chooses a mask from the previous code, four for code 1 and eight for code 2, and ORs it into the flag buffer going downward. It returns early when the matching count entry has its top bit set.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:210A
name: set_marker_mask_and_clear
description: Writes a marker mask into the flag entry for the current position, choosing between two masks depending on the previous code. When a count is nonzero, it scans back to the last flagged entry, clears its low nibble and sets bit two.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2160
name: accumulate_table_entries
description: Calls a sequence of unnamed routines depending on two state fields, then adds a stored word to each of eight consecutive long entries in the table at the state's table offset.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:21B8
name: compute_clamped_level_byte
description: Computes a scaled level from two inputs, clamps it to a narrow range and stores it as a byte in a table indexed by a stored position.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:21F2
name: clamp_value_and_store_char
description: Clamps a word value into a fixed lower and upper bound and stores the result as a byte at an offset from a table pointer.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:220C
name: step_levels_across_segment
description: Divides the difference between a base value and a stored input by a count, then steps a running level across the flagged entries of a segment, writing each result into the output table.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:22B6
name: adjust_table_values_loop
description: Computes the absolute difference between two table entries, scales it and adds it to a destination byte. It then scans backwards over flagged entries, applying scaled adjustments to them.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:230C
name: compute_flagged_entry_levels
description: For each flagged entry from the current index, computes scaled level and secondary values from the entry's stored parameters and writes them into two output tables. An extra adjustment applies when the flag bit is set.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2394
name: scale_and_back_scan_entries
description: Scales values in two output tables for each entry, then scans backwards through the flagged entries writing adjusted values until the start of the range is reached.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:23B2
name: compute_scaled_char_values
description: Loops backwards over the flagged entries, computing scaled values from two tables with multiplications and shifts and writing them to two destination tables. At the start of the range it copies a byte from a table and adjusts it.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:23CE
name: adjust_gap_scaled_values
description: Scans backwards for flagged entries and measures the gap to the previous flagged entry. When the gap is not two, it applies scaled adjustments to the values at both ends of the gap in the output tables.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:23E0
name: adjust_gap_scaled_values_alt
description: Register-based variant of the gap adjustment. For a flagged entry whose gap to the previous flagged entry is not two, it applies scaled adjustments to the values at both ends of that gap.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:240C
name: adjust_pair_values_rounded
description: Applies rounded, scaled updates to two pairs of table entries selected by the current indices, with a difference-based correction feeding the output table. It then loops backward over the flagged entries.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:242A
name: adjust_pair_values_partial
description: Applies rounded, scaled updates to one pair of table entries and a correction derived from their difference, then continues the flagged-entry walk with the same arithmetic.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:244A
name: adjust_pair_values_backscan
description: Applies rounded, scaled updates to a pair of entries, then scans backwards over flagged entries applying further scaled adjustments to those whose mask bits match.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:246A
name: adjust_pair_values_masked
description: Applies a rounded scaled update to a pair of entries and then runs the masked backward scan over flagged entries, copying values into the output table where the mask allows.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:248E
name: scan_running_maximum_values
description: Adds a byte offset to one table entry, then scans backwards over the earlier entries keeping a running maximum. Flagged entries receive scaled adjustments from that maximum.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2496
name: scale_pair_by_mode_factor
description: Chooses one of three scale factors from a mode value, then applies rounded scaled updates to a pair of entries in one table and a pair in another.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:24BE
name: scale_pair_by_argument_flag
description: Applies rounded scaled updates to a pair of table entries, choosing the scale factor and sign from an argument flag, then continues the flagged-entry scan.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:24DA
name: apply_flagged_scaled_tail
description: Applies rounded scaled updates to a pair of entries selected by the argument, then scans backwards over flagged entries copying values into the output table where the bit mask allows.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2506
name: apply_pair_scaled_then_scan
description: Applies a rounded scaled update to a pair of entries, adjusts a third entry when the argument and flag bits allow, and then scans backwards over flagged entries.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2532
name: scan_flagged_pairs_backward
description: Scans backwards through the flagged entries, applying rounded scaled updates to pairs of entries and copying mask-selected values between the output tables.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:25AC
name: scale_entry_by_running_maximum
description: Adds a scaled correction to one entry, takes the maximum over the earlier entries of a table, and subtracts a scaled version of that maximum from the output. It then scans backwards over flagged entries with matching mask bits, applying adjustments.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:25C0
name: scale_entry_by_maximum_alt
description: Register-based variant of the running-maximum scaling. It subtracts a scaled maximum of the earlier table entries from the output and applies the backward flagged-entry adjustments.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:25D4
name: update_maximum_scaled_entries
description: Tracks a running maximum over table entries while walking flagged positions. It subtracts a scaled version of that maximum from each output entry and applies a fixed adjustment where the mask nibble matches.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:25F8
name: scale_nibble_flagged_entries
description: Walks the entries backwards. For each entry with a nonzero high nibble it multiplies the output value by a signed factor chosen from one of its bits and adds the rounded product.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2608
name: scale_nibble_flagged_entries_alt
description: Register-based variant of the nibble-flagged scaling. It walks the entries backwards and adds the rounded product of the output value and a signed factor to each entry with a nonzero high nibble.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2632
name: scale_buffer_by_signed_factor
description: Walks a byte range backwards, skipping entries whose high nibble is zero. It adds a rounded product of the running accumulator and a signed factor chosen from the source byte to each output byte.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2642
name: compute_flagged_differences_tables
description: Stores the differences between a level table and two reference tables at each flagged position, then walks the flagged positions computing pairwise differences for the next adjustment pass.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:26E8
name: shift_and_copy_flagged_bytes
description: Shifts a run of bytes one position forward between two buffers, copying the start value and adjusting the moved entries by a fixed step. It advances through the flagged positions as it goes.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:270C
name: copy_run_with_nibble_scaling
description: Dispatches on a run length of one or two to an unnamed routine. Otherwise it copies a run of bytes forward between buffers and writes doubled low nibbles into the output table.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:273A
name: copy_run_nibble_scaled_loop
description: Copies a counted run of bytes forward between buffers, adding twice the low nibble of a flag entry to each copied output byte, then walks on to the next flagged position.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2762
name: smooth_run_pair_differences
description: Calls an unnamed routine, then walks the flagged positions. It moves each pair of adjacent values halfway toward their difference and copies the results into the output tables.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2770
name: smooth_run_pair_differences_alt
description: Alternate entry into the run smoothing pass. It applies the same halfway move toward neighbouring differences and copies the results into the output tables.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:277E
name: spread_run_quotient_levels
description: Fills the output for the current run with a constant level and nibble-scaled values. It then spreads the quotient of the run's end value over the flagged positions back to the run start.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:278A
name: spread_run_quotient_levels_loop
description: Loop form of the run level spreading. It writes constant and nibble-scaled values for each run position and spreads the quotient of the end value across the flagged positions.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:27C8
name: spread_run_step_values
description: Finds the run start from the flag entries and divides the level difference by the run length. It then steps through the run writing the stepped values, using a different offset for code 4 and a running maximum for code 8.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:27F2
name: spread_run_maximum_levels
description: Copies and steps values across a run by a fixed step. For code 8 it takes the maximum of the run and writes a scaled value at the run end.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:282C
name: write_run_maximum_level
description: Takes the maximum of the flagged values in the run, writes a scaled version of it at the end of the run, and copies the preceding entry into the output.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2834
name: accumulate_bytes_and_write_results
description: Accumulates a running maximum over a range of bytes and derives a scaled value from it. It writes that value and a derived value into several destination buffers, copying the preceding entry when the run has more than one element.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2864
name: adjust_flagged_entries_backward
description: Walks flagged entries backwards from the current index. For entries whose code carries a particular bit it applies scaled adjustments to the level tables and copies stepped values into the next table.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:287E
name: adjust_flagged_entries_stepping
description: Steps backwards through the flagged entries applying the same scaled level adjustments and stepped copies, returning once the start of the run is reached.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:28B8
name: apply_scaled_level_steps
description: Applies a rounded scaled step to the level tables at the current index, then repeats scaled adjustments across the following flagged entries until the run ends.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:28D2
name: apply_scaled_level_steps_alt
description: Register-based form of the scaled level step. It applies a rounded scaled step to the level tables at the current index and repeats the adjustments across the flagged entries that follow.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2906
name: scan_and_scale_run_levels
description: Applies a rounded scaled update to the level tables at the current index, scans forward through the code stream for the next marker, and applies further scaled updates weighted by the marker found.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:295C
name: scale_levels_backward_chain
description: Walks backwards through flagged entries, applying a rounded scaled update to the level tables at each position. For entries whose code carries marker bits it also updates the next table.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:296A
name: scale_levels_backward_chain_alt
description: Alternate entry into the backward level chain. It applies rounded scaled updates to the level tables at each flagged position and to the next table where marker bits are set.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2970
name: scale_levels_backward_tail
description: Finishes the backward level chain with a rounded scaled update at the final position, then returns once the start of the run is reached.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:298E
name: apply_scaled_delta_backward_scan
description: Applies a rounded scaled delta to two level buffers at the current index, then loops backwards over the flagged entries applying scaled adjustments to matching table entries until the index reaches zero.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:29A2
name: propagate_feedback_stream_values
description: Copies bytes forward between buffers while updating a feedback value by multiplying it with a table entry and shifting. It subtracts the feedback from each byte and writes the result to the output table.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:29A4
name: copy_adjust_bytes_feedback
description: Copies bytes between buffers, updates a feedback value by multiplying it with a table entry and shifting, subtracts the feedback from each byte, and writes the adjusted bytes to two output areas.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:29D4
name: check_narrator_flag_and_dispatch
description: Calls twelve unnamed routines in sequence, then calls one more unnamed routine when the secondary-buffer flag byte in the device state is nonzero.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2A4A
name: call_three_routines_in_sequence
description: Calls three other routines one after another and returns, holding no logic of its own.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2A6A
name: interpolate_and_store_bytes
description: Linearly interpolates between the first byte of a record and a byte selected by an index, storing each intermediate value at eight-byte intervals in the buffer.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2A92
name: walk_record_entries_until_end
description: Walks eight-byte entries, skipping those marked with a filler value, and returns at the terminator. Entries that are not at the expected position trigger an unnamed routine call before the walk continues.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2AA4
name: walk_record_entries_step
description: Steps through eight-byte entries, skipping filler-marked slots and calling an unnamed routine at each record boundary, until the terminator is reached.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2AB6
name: walk_record_entries_recurse
description: Calls an unnamed routine and then walks the eight-byte entries of a record until the terminator, calling another unnamed routine at each record boundary.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2ABA
name: skip_zero_bytes_in_records
description: Scans eight-byte records for the next nonzero byte, advancing across records and calling an unnamed routine at each record boundary, until the terminator.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2AD0
name: skip_zero_bytes_until_end
description: Advances through eight-byte records to the next nonzero byte, calling an unnamed routine at record boundaries, and returns when the terminator is reached.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2ADC
name: skip_zero_bytes_then_helper
description: Calls an unnamed routine, then scans eight-byte records for the next nonzero byte. It returns at the terminator and calls an unnamed routine whenever a record boundary is crossed.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2AE0
name: write_record_offsets_from_codes
description: Walks the code and count streams, advancing the output pointer by eight bytes per count. For flagged code pairs it adds fixed increments to the first and fourth bytes of the entries, until the terminator.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2B10
name: emit_record_codes_by_symbol
description: Walks the code and count streams like its neighbour. For flagged codes it writes a symbol byte chosen from one of three character codes, advancing the output by eight bytes per count.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2B6A
name: emit_symbol_runs_to_buffer
description: For each code, emits a run of symbol bytes chosen from one of three character codes, writing six bytes per repetition at a fixed stride. Other codes advance through the eight-byte records until the terminator.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2B70
name: emit_symbol_runs_alt
description: Register-based form of the symbol run writer. It emits runs of symbol bytes for each code, six bytes per repetition, and advances through the records until the terminator.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2B82
name: emit_symbol_runs_by_code
description: Writes symbol runs whose character is chosen from two codes, then advances through the eight-byte records for the remaining codes until the terminator.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2B92
name: emit_symbol_runs_comma
description: Writes runs of symbol bytes for the current code, using one character code for the comma code and another for the rest, then walks on to the next records.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2BA2
name: emit_default_symbol_runs
description: Writes runs of the default symbol byte for the current code and advances through eight-byte records, continuing until the terminator.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2BC6
name: copy_previous_record_for_codes
description: For codes one and two, copies the previous eight-byte record into each following record for the count given. For other flagged codes it sets bits in the record based on a flag mask and the count.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2BF2
name: copy_previous_record_masked
description: Copies the previous eight-byte record for codes one and two. For other flagged codes it updates the record's flag nibbles using the mask bits, until the terminator code is reached.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2C02
name: update_record_flag_nibbles
description: For flagged codes, updates the flag nibbles of the record using a mask and a computed half value. It clears a set of bytes in the previous record when the carry condition holds.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2C32
name: update_record_flag_nibbles_loop
description: Loops over the codes applying flag nibble updates to the current and offset records for flagged codes, advancing through the stream until the terminator.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2CEC
name: copy_previous_record_tail
description: Walks the code stream writing eight-byte records. It copies the previous record for codes one and two and otherwise applies the flagged nibble updates, returning at the terminator.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2D1C
name: remap_record_bytes_through_table
description: Walks eight-byte records until the terminator, replacing the first three bytes of each record with values from a translation table. Records marked with a filler value are skipped.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2D3E
name: fill_records_from_lookup_table
description: Writes three bytes into the current eight-byte record from a lookup table keyed by each index, then steps through the records until the matching stop value is found.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2D52
name: stub_return_without_work
description: Routine with no body beyond returning to its caller.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2D54
name: average_record_column_bytes
description: Sums the leading bytes of a group of records, adds a stored byte, divides by eight and stores the result in a marker byte. It moves on to the next group until a sentinel is found.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2D70
name: accumulate_record_column_sums
description: Accumulates the leading byte of successive records into a running sum, writing an averaged value into the group's marker byte each time six records have been summed.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2D86
name: weight_record_column_values
description: Sums weighted leading bytes across a group of records, combines the total with two reference bytes, divides by sixteen and stores the result in the group's marker byte. It stops at a sentinel.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2DA4
name: weight_record_column_values_loop
description: Loop form of the weighted record column sum. It accumulates weighted leading bytes over six records, then stores the scaled result into the group's marker byte until the sentinel.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2DCA
name: write_record_pattern_by_code
description: Writes a pattern byte into the seventh byte of each record for the given count. The value comes from the code: one fixed value for the letter codes B and E, another for the slash code, and flag-dependent values for the rest.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2DEC
name: write_record_pattern_alt
description: Register-based form of the record pattern writer. It writes the code's pattern byte into the seventh byte of each record for the count given, then continues through the streams.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2E38
name: write_record_pattern_tail
description: Writes the pattern byte for each record of the current count, advances both streams, and returns when the terminator is reached.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2E48
name: apply_pattern_offset_minus_six
description: Adds a fixed negative offset to the seventh byte of each record for the given count, choosing later offsets from the code stream, and returns at the terminator.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2E4C
name: apply_pattern_offset_tail
description: Adds the fixed negative offset to the seventh byte of each record of the current count and returns once the terminator is reached.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2E50
name: apply_pattern_offset_loop
description: Loop form of the pattern offset writer. It adds offsets to the seventh byte of each record for each code, and returns at the terminator when a code ends the run.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2E54
name: fill_pattern_constant_and_offsets
description: Writes a fixed negative constant into the seventh byte of each record for the count, then applies code-dependent offsets to the following records until the terminator.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2E68
name: apply_scaled_offset_to_records
description: Adds a value derived from the first byte of each record, scaled down by a fixed ratio, to the seventh byte of each record for the count, then continues through the code stream.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2E80
name: decode_nibble_checksum_bytes
description: Processes a byte array in two passes. It sums the low nibbles and then the high nibbles of groups of bytes, and writes the combined sum back into the third byte of each group, masking the nibble it replaces.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:5230
name: allocate_signal_and_wait_loop
description: Allocates a signal bit from the system, looks up the current task, and stores both in the device state. It then loops, calling an unnamed routine and waiting on the signal mask.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:526E
name: poll_message_port_loop
description: Repeatedly tests a state bit, sets a busy bit and calls a library routine that returns a message. When no message is returned it clears the busy flags and returns; otherwise it stores the message and calls an unnamed routine.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:52A4
name: clear_busy_flags
description: Clears two status bits in the device state flag byte, marking the port as idle.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:52B4
name: setup_speech_iorb_and_send
description: Fills the speech request block with buffer pointers and a timing value derived from a fixed constant divided by a stored rate. It then submits the request with the system's synchronous I/O call.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:5370
name: setup_audio_dma_channels
description: Copies a block of sample bytes into the output buffer, sets up the audio channel pointers and then enables the audio DMA channels by writing the DMA control register with its set bit.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:548A
name: mix_speech_samples_to_buffer
description: Computes each output sample by summing three table lookups taken from the sample and index tables. It writes the value to two output positions and counts down the block, calling unnamed routines when the block completes.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:5514
name: advance_sample_phase
description: Updates the sample phase accumulators and index, moving the source pointer when its counter reaches zero. For negative sample bytes it disables the audio DMA channels through the hardware register and calls an unnamed routine.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:558C
name: mix_channel_samples_by_volume
description: Loops over sample bytes, computing volume-scaled values for each channel from the sample table. It resets the counters at the end of each block and loads the next block pointer.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:5610
name: mix_samples_with_offsets
description: Produces each output sample by adding two table values selected from the sample nibbles. It counts down the block size and calls unnamed routines when the block completes, continuing while the channel is active.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:56AE
name: bounce_sample_position_and_mix
description: Advances a position counter by a step, reversing the step direction at the ends of the sample range, and writes mixed output bytes until the sample count is exhausted. It calls unnamed routines when a block boundary is reached.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:56DC
name: parse_sample_block_headers
description: Reads each sample block header and unpacks its fields into the device state. When the header marks an update it clears the parameter bytes of the following block.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:56EA
name: wait_io_and_disable_dma
description: Waits for each outstanding audio request with the system's wait call, then disables the audio DMA channel bits and clears the channel's active flag.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:573E
name: enable_dma_if_flag_set
description: Checks a flag bit in the device state and, when it is set, writes the DMA control register to enable the audio channels.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:5758
name: handle_audio_interrupt_reply
description: Interrupt-level handler that updates a counter and compares the current state byte with the stored one. When a matching request is pending it fills in its fields, unlinks it from the queue and replies to it through the system's message reply call.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:57CA
name: decrement_counter_and_enable_interrupts
description: Decrements a signed counter in the device state and, when it was zero or below, writes the interrupt enable register with its set bit so interrupts are re-enabled.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:57DA
name: stop_channel_records_and_wait
description: Marks each audio request record for the channel as pending and calls an unnamed routine for each. If the stop bit is clear, it disables the audio DMA, waits for the outstanding requests and resets the channel; otherwise it sets a flag bit and returns.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:57F6
name: queue_channel_requests_and_wait
description: Marks the channel's request records as pending and calls an unnamed routine for each. It waits on the outstanding requests and disables DMA when the stop bit is clear, and otherwise submits a request with a fixed command through the synchronous I/O call.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:5838
name: wait_channel_requests_and_reset
description: Waits on the channel's outstanding request with the system wait call, disabling the audio DMA when its enable bit is set. It then reads the DMA control status and resets the channel state.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:587A
name: set_channel_done_flag
description: Sets the done bit of the channel's status byte in the request record.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:S/Message:0:0000
name: write_message_to_output
description: Calls an unnamed routine to obtain the output handle and, when the result is not zero, calls the close-library unnamed routine and then the DOS write routine. A third unnamed routine runs before the program returns.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:S/Message:0:0034
name: open_dos_library
description: Opens dos.library through the exec OldOpenLibrary call and stores the returned library handle in a global variable.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:endcli:0:0136
name: copy_block_and_call_entry
description: Copies a block of sixteen longwords from a fixed offset into the buffer passed in, when that pointer is not null, then calls the routine whose address is held in a register.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:intro:0:0000
name: program_entry_references_text
description: Program entry point of the intro, eight instructions long, which refers to the text IMP! and makes one call to another routine. The decompiler timed out, so the description relies only on the recorded facts.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:intro:0:001A
name: write_background_color_register
description: Writes the background color hardware register, then passes control through a jump-table entry and one other routine. The decompiler timed out, so the description relies only on the recorded facts.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:intro:0:0048
name: unpack_backward_literal_run
description: Reads a header of pointers and a count, copies the stored bytes backward from the end of the block, then enters the bit-driven decoding loop that unpacks further runs.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:intro:0:009A
name: read_bits_from_stream_backward
description: Pulls bits from a byte stream that is read backwards. It shifts a bit buffer and fetches a new byte whenever the buffer empties, accumulating the bits through several shift steps.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:intro:0:00D2
name: decode_bit_coded_values
description: Decodes values by shifting bits out of the backward-read stream and combining them into counts and offsets. It then loops through a table-driven decode.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:intro:0:00F6
name: decode_length_table_five_bits
description: Reads bit-coded values and uses a lookup table indexed by the current count to set the length and offset fields. It loops over a five-step range.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:intro:0:00FC
name: decode_length_table_four_bits
description: Reads bit-coded values and uses a lookup table indexed by the current count to set the length and offset fields. It loops over a four-step range.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:intro:0:0102
name: decode_length_table_three_bits
description: Reads bit-coded values and uses a lookup table indexed by the current count to set the length and offset fields. It loops over a three-step range.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:intro:0:0108
name: decode_length_table_two_bits
description: Reads bit-coded values and uses a lookup table indexed by the current count to set the length and offset fields. It loops over a two-step range.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:intro:0:012C
name: decode_back_reference_lengths
description: Decodes a bit-coded count and offset pair from the backward-read stream, using a lookup table for the count's bit width. It loops once for each decoded element.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:intro:0:0168
name: copy_back_reference_bytes
description: Decodes a bit-coded distance and copies a run of earlier bytes into the output buffer going backwards, copying literal bytes from the stream as well. It returns when the output pointer reaches the start of the buffer.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:LIBS/TRANSLATOR.LIBRARY:0:0000
name: create_and_register_library
description: Creates the library structure through the system's MakeLibrary call and, when that succeeds, stores the library base data and registers it with AddLibrary. It returns failure when creation fails, and the code is library code from LIBS/TRANSLATOR.LIBRARY rather than game code.
